item.stem:
The diagram shows parallel lines $m$ and $n$ cut by transversal $t$. One same-side interior angle is marked $70^{\circ}$.

Which claim correctly gives the other same-side interior angle?

options.A: The other same-side interior angle is $110^{\circ}$, because same-side interior angles on parallel lines add to $180^{\circ}$.
options.B: The other same-side interior angle is $70^{\circ}$, because same-side interior angles on parallel lines are equal.
options.C: The other same-side interior angle is $20^{\circ}$, from $90^{\circ}-70^{\circ}$.
options.D: The other same-side interior angle is $140^{\circ}$, from doubling $70^{\circ}$.
